sections.h2: Government outlays behind the ₹60,000 crore headline add up to about ₹43,000 crore

chart.title: PLI Pharmaceuticals and Biopharma SHAKTI are the two largest outlays
chart.sub: Government outlay, ₹ crore, for each scheme in the post's table.
chart.source: Post's table 1; PIB; Policy Circle; India Briefing.

sections.means: Government outlays alone total about ₹43,000–44,000 crore, and the gap to ₹60,000 crore is private and state co-investment the schemes are built to attract.
sections.todo: Judge the push by each scheme's outlay and results, not by the ₹60,000 crore roll-up.

sections.h2: Bulk Drugs PLI sales were flat from December 2025 to March 2026

chart.title: Cumulative sales reached ₹3,792 crore in June 2026, after a flat quarter
chart.sub: Bulk Drugs PLI cumulative sales, ₹ crore, at each reported snapshot.

sections.means: The March 2026 figures sit almost exactly on December's, so they read as restated data rather than new growth.
sections.todo: Track the next snapshot for real movement before counting the flat quarter as a trend.

sections.h2: Investment attracted ran ahead of the ₹4,322 crore commitment by December 2025

chart.title: Attracted investment was ₹4,814 crore in December 2025 and ₹5,211 crore by June 2026
chart.sub: Bulk Drugs PLI committed figure and investment attracted, ₹ crore.
chart.source: Post's section 2; PSU Watch, June 2026 update.

sections.means: The Bulk Drugs PLI attracted ₹4,814 crore by December 2025 against a committed ₹4,322 crore, so investment is ahead of its own commitment.
sections.todo: Check whether investment keeps pace with the ₹6,940 crore outlay while the 43.45% China import share stays put.
